title: UTIITSL Documents Required for PAN Card
section: Indian Address issued by the employer  --- Page 11 --- CSF Additional documents for reprint of PAN card or corrections/changes in existing PAN card details Sr. No Document for ( Copy of ) Copy of PAN card / PAN allotment letter issued 1 Proof of PAN by ITD • Married ladies :- - Marriage certificate /marriage invitation card/publication of name change in official gazette/ copy of passport showing husband’s name/ certificate from a gazetted officer 2 Proof of change • Other than married ladies :- - Publication requested (POCR): of name change in official gazette or certificate from a gazetted officer ) Non Indicating change of individuals name from old to new • Non-individuals :- Revised registration certificate / deed or agreement as applicable • Transgender:- Transgender Certificate issued by the District Magistrate For minor corrections in core details (i.e. name, father’s name, date of birth), any proof of identity document prescribed under Sub-Rule 8(a) or 8(b) of 3 Rule 158 of the Income-tax Rules, 2026, indicating correct details, may be provided. In case communication as well as other address is mentioned, submit POA 4 for both the addresses.
